description: Describes a video the owner sent: what happens, who and what is on screen, the words on it, what is said, the sound and how it is shot. It spends tokens, so first call it with go false for its price and tell the owner; call it with go true only on their yes, or when they asked for it with that price already said. Its id comes from input.attached or attachment_read. It needs an act key, and spends the owner's tokens as the chat's same tool would: say the price before you spend.

go.description: false: only the price, nothing spent; true: describe it now, which spends tokens

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
